description: Ranked next-best action per habit, each with a rationale and a priority score. The cheapest endpoint, deterministic and CPU-only, so it is suitable for high-frequency loops. Costs $0.03 in USDC on Base.

habits.description: Up to 25 habits. Price is per CALL, not per habit — batch aggressively, sending 25 costs the same as sending one.

average_mood.description: Optional. Mean mood 1–10 on completion days.

mood_correlation.description: Optional. Correlation of mood with completion.

name: recommend_next_actions
